title: Partner co-borrower and payment anxiety
scenario: Same-sex couple buying a starter home; one partner calls but says the other is the co-borrower and must weigh in. He also worries the payment will be too high. Rep stays compliant.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi, is this Nikolai? This is Tamsin with Copperleaf Home Loans.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Hey Tamsin, yes. Good timing, I just got home.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Great. You and your partner are looking to buy?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, me and Sam. We've been renting a duplex for four years.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Exciting. What area are you looking in?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: East side, near the brewery district. Little bungalows over there.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Love that neighborhood. What price range?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Like three-twenty to three-fifty. But honestly, with rates where they are, I'm worried the payment would just be too much for us.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That's a really fair concern. The best way to know what's comfortable is to look at your full budget together rather than guess.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah. And Sam's going to be the co-borrower, so I really need him in on this before we go any further.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Absolutely. Would it help to set up a call with both of you?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah. He works nights though.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: How about a weekend? Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Saturday at ten works.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Perfect. Before then, could you each pull together a rough monthly budget? That'll help us talk about a comfortable payment.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Sure. I'm still nervous it'll be too high, though.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Totally understood. We'll go at your pace and look at different price points.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay. Thanks, that helps.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Talk to you both Saturday.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Sounds good.
